svg.text: Central case joint | SNL23 and native section overlay
Unchanged input-bearing scale and shaft origin. Green case, orange gasket, red fasteners.
The drawing does not establish the complete transverse bolt pattern. Casting and flange contours remain inferred.
SNL27/252: fourteen MX8 sets and two M326 seals. HB121 uses different joint hardware marks; discrepancy retained.
